sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete 120 units, as specified below, including 12 units of language study, which may include courses completed during study abroad or field schools, or an approved equivalent.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Ideally, students would complete six units of language study alongside their lower division requirements, and six units of language study alongside their upper division requirements.

sections.note:
The 12 units of language study may include any combination of lower or upper division language courses.
Students with demonstrated competence in languages other than English may have this language requirement reduced or waived at the discretion of the department chair.
With prior approval, students can also complete an upper division course at another university.

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a total of 18 units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor

sections.title: Relevant Topic Courses

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: With prior approval, students may complete a maximum of three lower and eight upper division units of relevant topic courses from outside the Department of World Languages and Literatures (courses offered at Simon Fraser University or our field schools and exchanges) by submitting the course description to the world languages and literatures advisor.

sections.note: The following pre-approved courses are appropriate.

sections.title: Study Abroad

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: World literature major students may complete up to 15 upper division units at other universities or other universities' field schools and exchanges with prior approval.

sections.note:
Students are encouraged to study abroad, through field schools or exchanges.
Submit the relevant course description to the world languages and literatures advisor well in advance of the course.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
